| description = Sought after for his [[Teachings of Gkrean]] used in the [[Circlet of the Falinkan]] quest [[Ralgyn's Promise]]. 

Find him in the rear stadium building of the arena, left of the three protectors, opposite of [[Semkak Prophet of Vallon]] and above the hallway where [[Vealok the Angry]] spawns.

Gkrean is a cleric mob capable of [[Complete Heal]], [[Gate]]ing and is immune to [[Stun]]s, so you'll need sufficient <s>melee players to push and interrupt it</s> [[Enchanter]]s to [[Mana Sieve]]. Be certain not to fight him near other cleric giants such as his guards, who may [[Complete Heal]] him as well.  Gkrean appears to have a new PH called High Priest of Tallon Zek.  HP is lower then Gkrean.  Dropped standard thurg armor piece.
